# MCP tools and prompts

`tfcensus mcp` serves these tools and prompts over stdio. This page comes from the server's own `tools/list` and `prompts/list` answers. See [tfcensus mcp](/cli/mcp) for the flags.

## Server instructions

The server sends this text to the client when it connects:

```text
tfcensus answers questions about a Terraform/OpenTofu and Terragrunt fleet on AWS from reports that earlier tfcensus runs saved: which units exist, what they manage, which states manage an ARN or ID (whois), what is unmanaged (scan_summary), backend audit findings and drift. The tools never call AWS, run terraform or terragrunt, or write anything, so answers are only as fresh as the saved files; check source.created and the warnings. Every result is the JSON envelope of tfcensus report or whois --index with --format json. When the envelope has page.next_cursor, call the same tool with only that cursor to get the rest.
```

## Tools

### audit_findings

Backend audit findings. Read-only.

Lists the state backend audit findings of the saved audit JSON, highest severity first.

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "account": {
      "description": "AWS account ID.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "cursor": {
      "description": "The next_cursor of an earlier result of this tool. Other arguments are then ignored.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "include_suppressed": {
      "description": "List suppressed findings too, with their suppression reason.",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "rule": {
      "description": "Check ID glob, such as S3-* or LK-STALE.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "severity": {
      "description": "Lowest severity to list: info, low, medium or high.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```

### drift_summary

Drift summary. Read-only.

Lists drifted and failed units and their drifted resources with attribute paths from the saved drift JSON; it runs no plan.

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "cursor": {
      "description": "The next_cursor of an earlier result of this tool. Other arguments are then ignored.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "status": {
      "description": "Unit status: drifted, failed, clean, early-exit or excluded. Default: drifted and failed.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "unit": {
      "description": "Unit path glob; * also matches /.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```

### inventory

Inventory per unit. Read-only.

Counts the managed resource instances in the saved state index per unit and TF type, with double-managed counts.

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "account": {
      "description": "AWS account ID.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "cursor": {
      "description": "The next_cursor of an earlier result of this tool. Other arguments are then ignored.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "region": {
      "description": "AWS region, such as eu-west-1.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "type": {
      "description": "TF resource type glob, such as aws_iam_*.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "unit": {
      "description": "Unit path glob; * also matches /.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```

### scan_summary

Scan summary. Read-only.

Gives per-account category counts and coverage of the last scan, counts per resource type, and its top double-managed and unmanaged resources, from the saved scan JSON or the newest scan cache snapshot.

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "account": {
      "description": "AWS account ID.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "category": {
      "description": "List this category instead of double-managed and unmanaged: managed, double-managed, unmanaged, other-iac, aws-managed, derived, ignored or undetermined.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "cursor": {
      "description": "The next_cursor of an earlier result of this tool. Other arguments are then ignored.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "region": {
      "description": "AWS region, or global. Counts are then per region.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "top": {
      "description": "Findings to list, 1 to 500. Default 50.",
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "type": {
      "description": "CloudFormation or layer type glob, such as AWS::EC2::*.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```

### units

Units. Read-only.

Lists the units and workspaces in the saved state index, with state status, instance count, accounts and regions.

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "cursor": {
      "description": "The next_cursor of an earlier result of this tool. Other arguments are then ignored.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "path": {
      "description": "Unit path glob; * also matches /, such as acme-live/prod/*.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "status": {
      "description": "State status: ok, absent, encrypted, unsupported or error.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```

### whois

Who manages a resource. Read-only.

Finds which units and addresses manage each ARN or TF resource ID in the saved state index, or which ownership rule explains an unmanaged one.

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "queries": {
      "description": "ARNs or TF resource IDs, such as arn:aws:s3:::acme-assets or sg-0123456789abcdef0.",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "type": [
        "null",
        "array"
      ]
    },
    "types": {
      "description": "TF resource types to look in, such as aws_security_group. Default: the type the ARN maps to, else every type.",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "type": [
        "null",
        "array"
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "queries"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## Prompts

### explain_unmanaged

Explain unmanaged resources.

Explains the unmanaged resources of the last scan by rule and proposes import, an ownership rule or a deletion review for each group, citing rule IDs and ARNs.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `account` | no | AWS account ID. Default: every account. |
| `type` | no | CloudFormation or layer type glob, such as AWS::EC2::\*. Default: every type. |

### triage_drift

Triage drift.

Sorts the drifted and failed units of the saved drift report into revert, adopt and investigate, citing unit paths, resource addresses and attribute paths.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `unit` | no | Unit path glob to triage; \* also matches /. Default: every unit. |
